name: Roshutsu / Hounyou / Inukan / Ninshin
original_name: 露出・放尿・犬姦・妊娠
source:
Middle aged teacher Sakaki saw a female student shoplifting.
He took a picture in order to blackmail her.

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ117516.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
中年老师坂木看到一名女学生入店行窃。
他拍了一张照片来敲诈她。

[来自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ117516.html]DLsite英文[/url]]
